title: policy.json: orchestrator
description: The orchestrator session itself: when it hands over to a fresh one (design parts 5.4 and 13.1).

handover_context_share.description: The share of its context window the orchestrator may use before it checkpoints and hands over to a fresh session, measured from its own usage.

handover_after_completions.description: How many completions an orchestrator session processes before it hands over to a fresh session, whatever its context says. Short-lived sessions keep each context small.
